blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user’s activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent.
To effectively assist users, they should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on the current task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user’s expertise and needs.
Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs.
However, existing datasets either remain limited to detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity.
Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion in a streaming setting and adapt guidance granularity to the user’s needs.
To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels, offering richer supervision for learning task progress and procedural context across different granularities. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and whether they can adapt when the requested guidance level changes.
We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across different backbones.
Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision consistently improves overall performance across various backbones, with gains of up to 9.6%p.
We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router.
Without additional fine-tuning of the guide model, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p in overall performance across four guidance-level transitions.
Our project page is available at https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/ .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Building AI assistants like JARVIS 1 1 1 JARVIS stands for “Just A Rather Very Intelligent System.” It is a fictional AI assistant used by Tony Stark in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, first appearing in Iron Man (2008). It assists Stark by managing information and controlling various systems and devices. that continuously understand their surroundings and proactively help users when needed has long been a human aspiration.
For example, a future smart-glasses assistant could recognize what a user is currently doing and provide guidance at an appropriate moment, and a future humanoid assistant robot could monitor task progress and proactively provide physical assistance to the user when help is needed ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Azad et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026a ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) .
A central requirement for realizing such AI assistants is proactiveness .
blocks.zh:
JARVIS 11 1 JARVIS代表着“一个非常聪明的系统”。 它是Tony Stark在"万能电影宇宙"中使用的虚构AI助手,最早出现在"铁人"(2008年). 它通过管理信息和控制各种系统和设备来协助斯塔克. 人们长期以来一直渴望不断了解他们的环境,并在需要时主动帮助用户。
例如,未来的智能眼镜助理可以识别用户当前正在做的事情,并在适当时机提供指导,未来的人造助理机器人可以监测任务进度,并在需要帮助时主动向用户提供身体帮助(王等,2026;夏等,2026;郑等,2026;赵等,2026;阿扎德等,2026;张等,2026;颜等,2026a;马等,2026;于等,2026.).
实现这种人工智能助理的核心要求是积极主动。

blocks.en:
Proactiveness refers to continuously observing the user’s activity in a streaming setting and deciding whether to provide new guidance or remain silent.
Building on this notion of proactiveness , a proactive AI assistant requires three core capabilities.
(1) It should provide appropriate guidance for the user’s task. Beyond simply recognizing objects, the assistant should understand the current situation and task progress in activities such as cooking, assembly, and repair, which require a sequence of events to achieve a goal.
(2) It should provide the next guidance after the currently guided event is completed. This requires tracking the progress of the guided event and providing the next guidance when it ends, while remaining silent when no new guidance is needed.
(3) It should provide guidance at a level appropriate to the user’s expertise and needs. The assistant should adjust the guidance granularity accordingly and adapt when the requested guidance level changes during an ongoing task.
blocks.zh:
主动性是指在流畅的环境下持续地观察用户的活动,并决定是提供新的指导还是保持沉默.
在主动性概念的基础上,主动性人工智能助理需要三个核心能力。
(1) 它应为用户的任务提供适当的指导。 助理除了简单地识别物体外,还应了解目前的情况,并负责烹饪、装配和修理等活动的进展,这些活动需要一系列活动来实现一个目标。
(2) 它应在目前指导的活动结束后提供下一个指导。 这需要跟踪所指导的活动的进展情况,并在活动结束时提供下一项指导,同时在不需要新的指导时保持沉默。
(3) 它应在适合用户专门知识和需要的水平上提供指导。 该助理应相应调整指导颗粒性,并在要求的指导级别在进行中任务时发生变化时进行调整。

blocks.en:
Although recent studies have introduced training datasets and benchmarks for proactive assistance, existing data do not sufficiently support these core capabilities.
Some datasets remain limited to detection-based proactive understanding, where models detect the occurrence of specific objects or events in a video stream and respond accordingly ( Li et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
Other datasets provide procedural guidance for the user’s task, but mainly provide guidance at a fixed granularity ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Kundu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Since a guided event may consist of multiple finer-grained events, fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about what has been completed and what remains, making it difficult to track progress and determine completion in a streaming setting.
Since a guided event also belongs to a broader procedure, such guidance provides limited context about its purpose and expected outcome, making it difficult to understand how the current event contributes to the overall procedure.
Fixed-granularity guidance further limits the ability to adjust the guidance level to the user’s expertise and needs or adapt when the requested level changes.
blocks.zh:
虽然最近的研究引入了培训数据集和主动援助的基准,但现有数据不足以支持这些核心能力。
一些数据集仍限于基于检测的主动理解,模型检测出视频流中特定物体或事件的发生并做出相应反应(李等,2025;林等,2026;王等,2025;赵等,2026;李等,2026b.).
其他数据集为用户的任务提供了程序指导,但主要为固定颗粒提供指导(Zhang等,2025b; Li等,2026a;Kundu等,2026;Liu等,2026).
由于被引导的活动可能包含多起更细的分量事件,因此固定的分量指导对已完成的和尚存的有限信息,使得难以在流出地跟踪进度和确定完成情况.
由于一项指导性活动也属于更广泛的程序,因此这种指导对其目的和预期成果提供了有限的背景,因此难以理解当前活动如何有助于整个程序。
固定方向性指导进一步限制了根据用户的专业知识和需要来调整指导水平的能力,或者在要求的级别发生变化时进行调整的能力.

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite for proactive AI assistance, comprising a training dataset, an evaluation benchmark, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system.
Our main contributions are as follows.
(1) We introduce ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training and ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation.
ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels, together with guidance timing, enabling models to learn both fine-grained task progress and higher-level procedural context and to generate guidance at different granularities.
ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time at each guidance level, and further assesses whether they can adapt when the requested guidance level changes during an ongoing task.
(2) We propose ProactiveCoach , a hierarchical guidance learning method that fine-tunes pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct to jointly learn phase-, step-, and action-level proactive guidance in a single model.
This enables different VLM backbones to learn hierarchical procedural understanding and determine what guidance to provide and when to provide it at each level.
(3) We build an adaptive guidance system by combining the fine-tuned VLM with a lightweight guidance router.
The VLM generates multi-level guidance, while the router selects the guidance level requested by the user, allowing the system to dynamically adjust guidance granularity during an ongoing task without additional fine-tuning of the guide model.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些局限性,我们采用了主动行动Coach软件包,用于主动提供人工智能援助,其中包括培训数据集、评价基准和通过适应性指导系统微调的自愿活动清单。
我们的主要贡献如下。
(1)我们引入了主动Coach-Information用于培训,主动Coach Bench用于评估.
积极主动的Coach-Instruct在阶段、步骤和行动层面提供分级结构的指导,以及指导时间,使模型能够学习精细的任务进度和更高层次的程序背景,并在不同颗粒区产生指导。
积极主动的Coach Bench评价模型是否在每个指导级别的适当时间提供适当的指导,并进一步评估当请求的指导级别在进行中的任务中发生变化时它们是否能够适应.
(2)我们提出"先发制人Coach",一种分级指导性学习方法,精细地调整预先培训的"先发制人Coach-Information"的VLM,在单一模式下共同学习阶段,步骤,行动层面的主动指导.
这使得不同的自愿补充材料骨干能够学习分级的程序理解,并确定在每一级别提供何种指导以及何时提供指导。
(3)通过将微调VLM与轻量级引导路由器相结合,构建适应性引导系统.
VLM生成多层次的指向,而路由器则选择用户所请求的指向级别,使系统能够在进行中的任务中动态地调整指向颗粒性,而无需对指向模型进行额外的微调.

blocks.en:
Our proposed dataset is constructed using Procedural Data Curation, Procedure Hierarchy Construction, and Proactive Guidance Generation, achieving an overall score of 4.27 in our human quality review.
We also demonstrate that our training data can be effectively applied across different pretrained VLM backbones.
Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision consistently improves overall performance across various backbones, with gains of up to 9.6%p.
Finally, our adaptive guidance system adapts the guidance level when the user’s request changes. Without additional fine-tuning of the guide model, it outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p in overall performance across four guidance-level transitions.
blocks.zh:
我们提议的数据集采用程序数据校正、程序等级构建和主动指导生成方法构建,在人的质量审查中总体得分达到4.27分。
我们还表明,我们的培训数据可以有效地应用到各种经过预先培训的VLM主干线上。
相较于固定的分级监管,分级监管不断提高各个骨干的整体性能,收益可达9.6%p.
最后,当用户的要求发生变化时,我们的适应性指导系统会调整指导级别。 如果不对指导模型进行额外的微调,它在四个指导级过渡的总体性能上就比内衬适应基线高57.1%p.

blocks.en:
Hierarchical video understanding aims to understand video content at multiple levels, from fine-grained actions to higher-level activities ( Song et al., 2023 ; Islam et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2025 ) .
HiREST ( Zala et al., 2023 ) connects video and moment retrieval with step-by-step descriptions, while GUIDE ( Liang et al., 2024 ) identifies common procedures across multiple videos and links them to the detailed steps in each video.
Ego4D-HCap ( Islam et al., 2024 ) recursively generates captions at multiple levels, from short action descriptions to long-form video summaries, while Action100M ( Chen et al., 2026 ) hierarchically segments videos and provides action and context annotations for segments of different durations.
However, hierarchical descriptions cannot be directly converted into guidance.
In proactive procedural assistance, the assistant must identify goal-relevant activities and determine what guidance to provide, when to provide it, and at what level of detail.
blocks.zh:
分级视频理解旨在多层次理解视频内容,从精细动作到更高层次的活动(Song等,2023;Islam等,2024;Kang等,2025.).
HiREST(Zala等,2023年)将视频和瞬间检索与分步描述相接,而GUIDE(Liang等,2024年)则确定跨多段视频的共同程序,并链接到每段视频的详细步骤.
Ego4D-HCap(Islam等,2024年)在多个层面递归生成字幕,从短动作描述到长式视频摘要,而Action100M (Chen等,2026)分层分出视频,为不同时间段提供动作和上下文说明.
然而,等级描述不能被直接转化为指导.
在主动提供程序协助时,助理必须确定与目标有关的活动,并确定提供何种指导、何时提供以及详细程度。

blocks.en:
Unlike reactive AI, which typically responds to explicit user queries, proactive AI determines not only what to say but also whether and when to respond based on a continuous stream of observations. Some studies remain limited to detection-based proactive understanding, where models detect specific objects or events in a video stream and respond accordingly ( Li et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
More recently, proactive AI assistance has moved beyond such detection-based settings, requiring models to determine what guidance is needed and when to provide it based on the user’s task goal and ongoing task context ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Kundu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
与通常响应明确用户询问的被动AI不同,主动AI不仅决定了该说什么,而且决定是否和何时根据连续的观察流做出回应. 一些研究仍限于基于检测的主动理解,模型在视频流中检测出特定物体或事件并做出相应反应(Li等,2025;Lin等,2026;Wang等,2025;赵等,2026;Li等,2026b.).
最近,主动的AI援助已经超越了这种基于检测的设置,需要模型来确定需要何种指导以及何时根据用户的任务目标和持续的任务背景提供指导(张等,2025年b; Li等,2026a;Kundu等,2026;Liu等,2026.).

blocks.en:
ProAssist ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) and StreamPro-Bench ( Li et al., 2026a ) focus on providing proactive step-level guidance according to task progress.
Pro 2 Bench ( Kundu et al., 2026 ) further considers recognizing when the user’s behavior does not follow the intended procedure and providing recovery guidance, while GuideMe ( Liu et al., 2026 ) covers task completion verification, error detection, and corrective guidance.
However, existing datasets and benchmarks primarily focus on step-level guidance, providing limited supervision and evaluation for understanding progress and completion across procedural levels.
They also provide limited evaluation of whether models can provide guidance across different procedural levels and adapt when the requested guidance level changes.
blocks.zh:
ProAsist(Zhang等,2025b)和StreamPro-Bench(Li等,2026a)侧重于根据任务进度提供主动的分步指导.
Pro 2 Bench(Kundu等人,2026年)进一步考虑在用户的行为没有遵循预定程序并提供恢复指导时予以承认,而GuideMe(Liu等人,2026年)则涵盖任务完成核实、出错发现和纠正指导。
然而,现有的数据集和基准主要侧重于分级指导,为了解各个程序层面的进展和完成情况提供有限的监督和评价。
它们还提供了有限的评价,说明模型是否能够在不同程序层面提供指导,并在要求的指导层面发生变化时进行调整。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集概览

blocks.en:
To support hierarchical procedural understanding for proactive procedural assistance, we structure goal-relevant guidance into three levels: phase, step, and action.
This hierarchy allows lower-level progress to provide evidence for the completion of guided events, while higher-level context helps clarify their purpose and expected outcome.
Based on this design, we construct ProactiveCoach-Instruct and ProactiveCoachBench with hierarchically structured guidance and guidance timing at each level, supporting learning and evaluation across procedural levels. This hierarchical structure also supports guidance at different granularities according to the user’s needs.
blocks.zh:
为支持对主动程序援助的分级程序理解,我们将目标相关指导分为三个层面:阶段、步骤和行动。
这种等级制度允许较低级别的进展为完成所指导的活动提供证据,而较高级别的情况有助于澄清其目的和预期成果。
基于这一设计,我们构建了积极主动的Coach-Instruction和积极主动的Coach Bench,每个级别都有层次结构化的指导和指导时间安排,支持跨程序层面的学习和评价. 这种等级结构还根据用户的需要,支持在不同颗粒地上的指导。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 illustrates the hierarchically structured guidance in ProactiveCoach-Instruct and ProactiveCoachBench.
A phase is a high-level unit that achieves an intermediate goal through multiple steps, while a step is a procedural unit that achieves a specific outcome through multiple actions.
An action is an observable fine-grained event that can be guided independently and serves as the finest guidance level.
Each sample consists of a task goal, a video, and hierarchical guidance annotations, with each guidance sentence linked to its event span and guidance time.
Guidance timing is defined independently at each level. The next guidance is provided immediately after the previously guided event at that level ends.
For each video chunk, we combine multi-level guidance in phase, step, and action order into a single <response> .
If no new guidance is required at any level, the chunk is labeled <silent> .
blocks.zh:
图2显示了主动Coach-Instructiont和主动Coach Bench中的分级结构指导.
一个阶段是通过多步骤实现中间目标的高级单位,而一个步骤则是通过多动作实现特定结果的程序单位.
一项行动是可观察到的精心策划的事件,可以独立指导,并且是最佳的指导水平。
每个样本包括任务目标、视频和分级指导说明,每个指导句都与其活动周期和指导时间相挂钩。
指导时间在每个级别上独立确定. 下一个指导是在先前指导的这一级活动结束后立即提供的。
对于每个视频块,我们把不同阶段、步骤和行动顺序的多层次指导合并为一个 " 反应 " 。
如果在任何级别不需要新的指导,则块被标记为 " silent " 。

blocks.en:
The data contain 11,119 samples constructed from 7,232 first-person videos across eight source datasets: Ego4D Goal-Step ( Song et al., 2023 ) , Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) , EPIC-KITCHENS ( Damen et al., 2018 ) , CaptainCook4D ( Peddi et al., 2024 ) , EgoExoLearn ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , HD-EPIC ( Perrett et al., 2025 ) , WTaG ( Bao et al., 2023 ) , and HoloAssist ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
As shown in Figure 4 , the data cover diverse domains, including assembly, repair, and electronics; food and beverage preparation; and household and gardening activities.
We use 10,007 samples as ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training and 1,112 samples as ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation.
On average, each sequence contains 4.14 phases, with 3.35 steps per phase and 2.47 actions per step.
Further dataset statistics are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
这些数据包含11 119个样本,这些样本来自8个源数据集的7 232个第一人称视频: 电子化4D Goal-Step (Song等, 2023), Ego-Exo4D (Grauman等, 2024), EPIC-KITCHENS (Damen等, 2018), Cook4D队长. (Peddi等,2024). EgoExoLearn (Huang等,2024). HD-EPIC (Perrett等,2025). WTaG (Bao等,2023). HoloAsist (Wang等,2023).

我们使用10 007个样本作为培训的主动Coach-Instruct,1 112个样本作为评估的主动Coach Bench。

blocks.en: The proposed dataset is constructed through three stages: procedural data curation, procedure hierarchy construction, and proactive guidance generation, as shown in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,拟议数据集通过三个阶段构建:程序数据解析、程序分级构建和积极主动的指导生成。

blocks.en:
We filter goal-oriented procedural videos from eight egocentric video datasets.
The source datasets may contain videos that are unsuitable for procedural assistance, such as those with unclear task goals or insufficient coverage of key events.
Therefore, in procedural video selection, we use GPT-4.1-mini to assess the clarity of the task goal and the coverage of key events based on the existing annotations, and retain videos suitable for procedural assistance.
In addition, the source datasets contain annotations with different levels of granularity, inconsistencies with the video, or missing relevant events.
To address these issues, we perform video-grounded recaptioning using Gemini 2.5 Flash with the selected videos and their existing annotations.
The model revises captions that do not match the video, adds missing captions, and aligns each caption with its corresponding temporal segment in the video.
blocks.zh:
我们从8个以自我为中心的视频数据集中过滤面向目标的程序视频。
源数据集可能包含不适合程序协助的视频,如任务目标不明确或对关键事件报道不足的视频.
因此,在程序视频选择中,我们使用GPT-4.1-mini来评估任务目标的明确性和根据现有说明对关键事件的报道,并保留适合程序协助的视频.
此外,源数据集还包含有说明,分出出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分

该模型修改了与视频不符的字幕,增加了缺失的字幕,并和视频中相应的时间段对齐了每个字幕.

blocks.en:
The recaptioned annotations may still include content that is not necessary for accomplishing the task goal.
Therefore, in goal-relevant annotation filtering, we use GPT-4.1-mini to retain only the annotations necessary for achieving the task goal.
Then, we perform hierarchical procedure construction to organize the selected annotations into a procedural hierarchy.
First, we consolidate the selected annotations into actions, each representing an independent unit of execution.
We then group multiple actions into a step representing a procedural unit, and multiple steps into a phase representing an intermediate goal, forming a phase–step–action hierarchy.
The temporal span of each action is defined by its observed start and end times in the video.
The temporal spans of each step and phase are then defined to cover their child actions and steps, respectively.
This produces a hierarchical procedure structure that serves as the basis for hierarchically structured guidance.
However, this process may produce redundant structures where different hierarchical levels describe the same execution.
We therefore perform hierarchy checking and refinement to eliminate these redundancies and ensure hierarchical consistency.
Using GPT-4.1-mini, we check whether each step is properly composed of its actions, each phase is properly composed of its steps, and their temporal spans are consistent.
Based on this check, we reconstruct the hierarchy and repeat the refinement process until the structure is consistent.
blocks.zh:
复述说明可能仍然包括为实现任务目标所不需要的内容。
因此,在与目标相关的注释过滤中,我们使用GPT-4.1-mini只保留实现任务目标所必需的说明.
然后,我们进行分级程序构建,将选定的说明组织为分级程序。
首先,我们将选定的说明合并为行动,每个行动代表一个独立的执行单位。
然后,我们将多个行动组合为一个代表程序单元的步骤,将多个步骤组合为一个代表中间目标的阶段,形成一个阶段-步骤-行动层次。
每个动作的时间跨度由视频中观察到的起止时间来定义.
然后,每一步骤和阶段的时间跨度被确定为分别涵盖儿童行为和步骤。
这产生了一种分级程序结构,作为分级指导的基础。
然而,这一过程可能会产生冗余结构,不同等级级别描述的是相同的执行.
因此,我们进行等级检查和改进,以消除这些冗余之处,并确保等级的一致性。
使用GPT-4.1-mini,我们检查每个步骤是否正确由它的行动组成,每个阶段是否正确由它的步骤组成,它们的时间跨度是否一致.
基于这一检查,我们重建了等级,并重复了完善过程,直到结构一致.

blocks.en:
To construct hierarchically structured guidance, we perform level-specific guidance generation.
Given the constructed phase–step–action hierarchy and the user’s goal information at each level, we generate proactive guidance for the phase, step, and action levels by using GPT-4.1-mini.
Then, we perform guide timing assignment to align the generated guidance with task progress based on the temporal spans at each level.
At each level, the next guidance is assigned to the frame immediately after the current guided event ends.
If the current guided event ends at only one level, we provide the next guidance only for that level.
If guided events end at multiple levels at the same time, we provide the next guidance for all corresponding levels together.
If no guided event ends at a given frame, we label that frame as silent.
Through this process, we construct ProactiveCoach-Instruct and ProactiveCoachBench with hierarchically structured guidance for proactive AI assistance.
blocks.zh:
为了构建分级结构的指导,我们进行针对不同层次的指导生成.
考虑到各个层次的构建阶段-步骤-行动层次和用户的目标信息,我们通过使用GPT-4.1-mini来为阶段、步骤和行动层次提供积极的指导。
然后,我们执行指导性时间安排任务,根据每个级别的时间跨度,使产生的指导与任务进展相配合。
在每个级别上,在目前被引导的活动结束后,下一个指导立即被分配到框架.
如果目前的指导性活动仅以一个级别结束,我们只为这一级别提供下一个指导。
如果指导性活动同时以多层次结束,我们就为所有相应层次共同提供下个指导。
如果没有向导事件以特定框架结束,我们把框架标为沉默.
通过这一进程,我们构建了积极主动的Coach-Introduct和积极主动的Coach Bench,并有分层结构的指导,用于主动的AI援助.

blocks.en: 3.3 Quality Review
blocks.zh: 3.3 质量审查

blocks.en:
We conduct a human evaluation to assess whether the annotations accurately reflect the procedural structure of the video and provide appropriate guidance.
We sample 50 examples from ProactiveCoachBench and evaluate them at the phase, step, and action levels using four criteria: video alignment , hierarchical coverage , goal relevance , and guidance quality . Video alignment measures whether the annotated content, temporal spans, and guidance timings are consistent with the observed video. Hierarchical coverage evaluates whether the lower-level executions sufficiently cover the content required by the higher-level procedure, while goal relevance measures whether the generated guidance contributes to achieving the task goal. Guidance quality evaluates whether each guidance sentence clearly and accurately describes what the user should do at the corresponding level.
As shown in Figure 4 , the annotations achieve scores above 4.0 on most evaluation criteria, with an overall score of 4.27.
These results indicate that the annotations reliably capture video-grounded procedural hierarchies and provide goal-relevant guidance at each level.
Details of quality review are provided in Appendix D .

我们进行了一次人性评价,以评估说明是否准确地反映了视频的程序结构并提供适当的指导。
我们用四个标准, 即视频对接、分级覆盖、目标相关性和指导质量, 视频对标注内容、时间跨度和指导时间是否与所观察的视频一致。 分级覆盖评估低级处决是否足以涵盖更高一级程序所要求的内容,而目标相关性衡量生成的指导是否有助于实现任务目标。 指导质量评价每个指导句是否清晰准确地描述了用户在相应级别上应该做什么.
如图4所显示,说明在大多数评价标准上得分高于4.0,总得分为4.27。
这些结果表明,说明可靠地记录了基于视频的程序等级,并在每一级别上提供与目标有关的指导。

blocks.en: 4 ProactiveCoach
blocks.zh: 4 积极可可

blocks.en:
We propose ProactiveCoach, a hierarchical guidance learning method that jointly learns phase-, step-, and action-level proactive guidance in a single vision-language model (VLM).
Using ProactiveCoach-Instruct, we train the model to learn hierarchical procedural understanding across the three levels.
For supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we organize guidance across the three levels into a single output sequence that preserves their hierarchical relationships and guidance timing.
Each guidance sentence is paired with its level and a hierarchical ID that encodes the parent–child structure.
This makes the relationship between lower-level events and higher-level procedural units explicit in the training targets.

我们提出先发制人Coach,一种分级指导学习方法,在单一的视觉语言模式(VLM)中共同学习阶段,步骤,行动层面的先发制人指导.
使用主动 教练指导,我们训练模式 学习分级程序理解 跨三个层次。
对于有监督的微调(SFT),我们将三个级别的指导组织成单一的产出序列,保持其等级关系和指导时间.

这使得低级活动与高级程序单位之间的关系在培训目标中明确.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate on ProactiveCoachBench and the publicly available validation split of EgoProactive, an existing benchmark for proactive procedural assistance.
We evaluate guidance performance at the phase, step, and action levels on ProactiveCoachBench, and at the step level on EgoProactive ( Kundu et al., 2026 ) .
We compare against four groups of models: Proprietary Frontier Models ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Singh et al., 2025 ) , Multimodal Models ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Team, 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026b ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , Guidance Assistant Models ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , and Streaming Models ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) .
For guidance assistant models, we use ProAssist, whose model weights are publicly available, and for streaming models, we use VideoLLM-Online, MMDuet2, and VideoChat3-4B as baselines.
The details of baselines are provided in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们评价积极主动的Coach Bench和EgoProaction的公开验证,这是主动程序援助的现有基准。
我们评价主动Coach Bench的阶段、步骤和行动层面的指导业绩,以及EgoProactive的阶段指导业绩(Kundu等,2026年)。
我们比较了四组模型: 独有边界模型(Comanici等人,2025年;Anthropic,2025年;Singh等人,2025年),多式联运 模型(Bai等,2025;Team,2026;Yan等,2026b;Zhu等,2025;Zhang等,2025a;Zhang等,2024),指导 助理模型(张等,2025b),和流模型(陈等,2024;王等,2026;李等,2026c.
对于指导助理模型,我们使用ProAssist,其模型权重是公开的;对于流线模型,我们使用VideoLLM-Online,MMDuet2和VideoChat3-4B作为基线.
基准详情见附录E.2。

blocks.en:
Following prior evaluation protocols ( Kundu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate models at predefined anchor points.
These anchor points are categorized into Response Anchors and Silent Anchors .
At Response Anchors , the model is expected to generate appropriate guidance, whereas at Silent Anchors , it is expected to remain silent and avoid providing unnecessary guidance.
For ProactiveCoachBench, we use all ground-truth guidance timestamps as Response Anchors .
For Silent Anchors , we randomly sample a timestamp with no ground-truth guidance from the central 30–70% of each phase, step, or action segment.
For EgoProactive, we use the original evaluation anchor points.
At each anchor, all models receive the most recent 10 seconds of video preceding the anchor, together with the complete ground-truth dialogue history prior to that point.
We use ground-truth dialogue history rather than model-generated responses to prevent previous incorrect or missed guidance from affecting subsequent decisions, enabling a fair comparison across models under the same dialogue history.
This protocol therefore evaluates both whether the model correctly decides when to provide guidance and whether the provided guidance is appropriate.
blocks.zh:
遵循先前的评价规程(Kundu等,2026;Liu等,2026),我们在预先确定的锚点评价模型.
这些锚点被归类为反应锚地和无声锚地。
在“反应控制器”中,预计该模型将产生适当的指导,而在“沉默控制器”中,预计将保持缄默并避免提供不必要的指导。
我们使用所有地面真实的制导时间戳作为反应控制器。
我们随机抽取一个时间戳,
对于"Ego Provaive",我们使用最初的评价锚点.
在每个主播中,所有模型都收到主播前最近的10秒视频,以及在此之前完整的地-地-地对话历史.
我们使用地面-真相对话历史,而不是模型生成的对策,以防止先前不正确或错失的指导影响随后的决定,从而能够在同一对话历史中公平比较各种模式。
因此,该议定书既评估模型是否正确决定何时提供指导,又评估所提供的指导是否适当。

blocks.en: We use sF1, gF1, and PQS to evaluate proactive procedural assistance, following prior work ( Kundu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用SF1、gF1和PQS来评估主动程序援助,此前的工作(Kundu等,2026;Liu等,2026)。

blocks.en:
sF1 jointly evaluates how well the generated guidance matches the ground-truth guidance and whether the model provides all necessary guidance.
We first match ground-truth and generated guidance one-to-one based on both timing and content, and sum the semantic similarities of the matched pairs.
Then, we compute sPrecision and sRecall by dividing this sum by the numbers of generated and ground-truth guidance instances, respectively.
sF1 is calculated as the harmonic mean of sPrecision and sRecall ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
SF1联合评价所生成的指导与地面真实指导的匹配程度,以及模型是否提供了所有必要指导。
我们首先匹配地面真相,并根据时间和内容产生一对一的指导,并汇总对应对子的语义相似性.
然后,我们计算精确度和召回度,将这一总和除以生成的和地面真实指导实例的数目。
sF1被计算为"精密"和"回想"(刘等,2026.

blocks.en:
gF1 evaluates whether the model correctly decides when to provide guidance and when to remain silent.
It considers only whether the model responds or remains silent at each anchor point and does not consider the guidance content.
We compute precision and recall separately for response and silence, obtain the corresponding F1 scores, and calculate gF1 as their geometric mean ( Kundu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
gF1评价模型是否正确决定何时提供指导,何时保持沉默.
它只考虑模型在每一个锚点是响应还是保持沉默,而不考虑指导内容.
我们分别计算精确度和回想以反应和沉默,获得相应的F1分数,并计算出gF1作为其几何平均值(Kundu等,2026年).

blocks.en:
PQS jointly evaluates response–silence decisions and the quality of the provided guidance.
At a silent anchor, the model receives a score if it remains silent and receives zero otherwise.
At a response anchor, the model receives a score based on the relevance, specificity, actionability, and conciseness of the generated guidance, and receives zero if it remains silent.
PQS is computed by averaging these scores across all anchor points ( Kundu et al., 2026 ) .
We use GPT-5.2 to evaluate guidance content quality.
Details of the metrics are provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
PQS联合评价反应-沉默决定和所提供的指导的质量。
在无声主播时,如果该模型保持无声并收到零,否则则获得分数.
在一个响应主锚上,模型根据生成的指向的相关性,特异性,可操作性和简洁性获得分数,如果保持静默,则获得零分.
PQS是通过所有锚点的平均值计算出来的(Kundu等人,2026年)。
我们使用GPT-5.2来评价指导内容质量.
衡量标准的细节见附录F。

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3-VL-4B/8B and Qwen3.5-4B/9B as backbone models and train for three epochs using eight B200 GPUs.
Videos are sampled at 1 FPS and grouped into 2-second chunks, with the model deciding whether to respond at each chunk.
We apply a causal block-sparse attention mask that restricts each token to frames from the current and preceding 10 seconds, while preserving access to the ground-truth instruction and all previous response and silence tokens.
Detailed training configurations are provided in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们使用Qune3-VL-4B/8B和Qune3.5-4B/9B作为骨干模型并使用8个B200GPU为3个纪元进行列车.
视频在1 FPS 中进行抽样,并分成2秒块,模型决定是否在每个块中响应.
我们使用一个因果块分解的注意口罩,将每个符号限制在从当前和10秒之前的帧上,同时保留对地真相指示和所有先前的响应和沉默符号的访问.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 2 , our method consistently achieves higher overall performance than the baselines across all guidance levels on ProactiveCoachBench.
A higher sF1 indicates that the generated guidance is semantically well aligned with and sufficiently covers the ground-truth guidance.
A higher gF1 indicates that the model more accurately determines when to provide guidance and when to remain silent.
A higher PQS indicates better overall performance in both response–silence decisions and guidance quality.
Our method shows strong performance across all metrics, with consistent improvements across different backbones.

一个更高的gF1表示,模型更准确地决定了何时提供指导和何时保持沉默.
较高的PQS表明,在反应-沉默决定和指导质量两方面的总体表现都较好。
我们的方法显示所有衡量标准都表现良好,不同骨干部门不断改进。

blocks.en:
Our method also shows strong performance across all metrics on the EgoProactive validation set.
Some base models achieve relatively high sF1 but very low gF1, indicating that they tend to respond even when no guidance is needed.
Conversely, some models show relatively low sF1 but high PQS, indicating that they tend to remain silent even when a response is required.
Our method consistently achieves higher Avg. scores than the base models across various backbones.

反之,有些型号显示SF1相对较低但PQS较高,表明即使需要回应,它们也倾向于保持沉默.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies and Analysis

blocks.en:
Table 6 compares step-only supervision with hierarchical supervision that jointly learns phase-, step-, and action-level guidance across different backbones.
Hierarchical supervision consistently improves sF1, gF1, PQS, and Avg. across all backbones.
These results show that learning hierarchically structured guidance not only enables guidance at multiple levels but also improves step-level proactive assistance.

这些结果表明,学习分级指导不仅有助于在多层次上提供指导,而且有助于改进分级主动援助。

blocks.en:
Table 6 compares step-only, phase–step, step–action, and phase–step–action supervision to analyze the effect of additional guidance levels.
Adding either phase- or action-level supervision improves step-level performance over step-only supervision, and using all three levels achieves the highest performance.
These results suggest that action-level supervision helps the model understand what actions make up each step and how they are progressing, providing useful evidence for determining whether the step is complete.
Phase-level supervision provides complementary context about the purpose and expected outcome of the current step and how it contributes to the overall procedure.
These results support the benefit of learning hierarchically structured guidance for step-level proactive assistance.

blocks.zh: 图6:带有轻量级路由器的指导级适应. 主动 教练生成多层次的引导,而路由器则选择用户请求的关卡.

blocks.en:
We examine whether a base model can perform multi-level proactive guidance through prompting alone, without fine-tuning on hierarchically structured guidance.
Table 6 compares zero-shot Qwen3.5-4B with our fine-tuned model under the same multi-level prompt and three-level GT history.
Fine-tuning substantially improves performance across all three guidance levels.
These results suggest that prompting alone is insufficient for reliable multi-level proactive guidance, while training on hierarchically structured guidance helps the model learn the relationships across procedural levels and provide appropriate guidance at each level.
blocks.zh:
我们审查一个基础模型是否能够通过单独推动,而不是对层次结构化指导进行微调,来进行多层次的主动指导。
表6将零射出Qwen3.5-4B与我们同为多级即时和三等GT历史的微调模型进行比较.
精细调整大大地改善了所有三个指导级别的业绩。
这些结果表明,单靠催化不足以提供可靠的多层次的主动指导,而分级指导的培训则有助于模型学习跨程序层面的关系,并在各个层面提供适当指导。

blocks.en:
A practical proactive procedural assistant should adapt its guidance level when the user’s request changes during an ongoing task.
As illustrated in Figure 6 , our system separates guidance generation from guidance-level selection.
Our trained model generates guidance at the three levels, while a lightweight LLM router selects which level to present based on the user’s request.
Because the two modules operate asynchronously and independently, the displayed guidance level can change without modifying or fine-tuning the guide model.
blocks.zh:
当用户的请求在进行中的任务中发生变化时,实际积极的程序助理应调整其指导水平。
如图6所示,我们的系统将指导生成与指导层次的选择分开。
我们经过训练的模型在三个级别产生指导,而一个轻量级的LLM路由器则根据用户的要求选择哪一个级别。
由于两个模块同步独立运行,所显示的指向级别可以改变而无需修改或微调指向模型.

blocks.en:
We evaluate this on four level transitions: Step → \rightarrow Phase, Step → \rightarrow Action, Phase → \rightarrow Step, and Action → \rightarrow Step.
For the baseline, the level-change request is added to the dialogue history, and the model is prompted to adjust its guidance level accordingly.
In our system, the router handles the level change while the guide model continues to generate multi-level guidance.
As shown in Table 6 , our system improves overall performance by 57.1%p on average across the four transitions compared with the in-context adaptation baseline.
For the baseline, the previous dialogue history contains guidance consistently provided at the original level, making it difficult to adapt to a new level through in-context prompting alone.
In contrast, separating guidance generation from level selection allows our system to change the displayed guidance level without being constrained by the previous guidance history.
These results show that our design can reliably adapt guidance granularity to the user’s request without additional fine-tuning of the guide model.
blocks.zh:
我们通过四个层次的过渡来评估这一点: 步子 右转 阶段 步骤 ~ 右翼行动 阶段 ~ 右翼行动 ~ 右翼行动 ~
对于基准,水平变化请求被加入到对话历史中,并促使模型相应调整其指导水平.
在我们的系统中,路由器处理关卡变化,而向导模型则继续生成多级向导.
如表6所示,我们的系统在四个过渡阶段与内在适应基线相比,平均提高了57.1%。
就基线而言,前一次对话的历史中包含在最初一级一贯提供的指导,因此很难单独通过内在提示来适应新的一级。
相形之下,将引导生成与级别选择相分离,使我们的系统可以改变所显示的指导级别,而不受之前的指导历史的限制.
这些结果表明,我们的设计可以可靠地使指导颗粒性适应用户的要求,而无需对指导模型作进一步的微调.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we explored hierarchical procedural understanding for proactive AI assistance.
Existing datasets either remain limited to detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity, limiting supervision for tracking task progress and adapting guidance granularity.
We introduced ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training and ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, providing hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels.
We further proposed ProactiveCoach, a hierarchical guidance learning method that jointly learns multi-level proactive guidance in a single vision-language model.
Our method consistently improves proactive assistance across different backbones, and our adaptive guidance system supports guidance-level changes without additional fine-tuning of the guide model.
We believe that our proposed datasets and method provide a useful foundation for future research on proactive AI assistance.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们探讨了对大赦国际主动援助的分级程序理解。
现有的数据集仍然限于基于检测的主动理解,或者在固定颗粒地提供程序指导,限制对跟踪任务进展和调整指导颗粒地的监督。
我们为培训引入了主动Coach-Information,为评估引入了主动Coach Bench,在阶段、步骤和行动层面提供了分级指导。
我们进一步提出了"先行先试",一种分级指导学习方法,以单一的愿景语言模式共同学习多层次前行指导.
我们的方法始终如一地改进不同骨干部门之间的主动援助,我们的适应性指导系统支持指导层面的改变,而无需对指导模式作额外的微调.
我们认为,我们提议的数据集和方法为今后主动提供AI援助的研究提供了有益的基础。

blocks.en:
Video alignment evaluates whether the annotated content, temporal spans, and guidance timing are consistent with the observed video.
Guidance may be provided before the next execution begins.
However, guidance that is provided excessively early or late, or unnecessarily repeats a completed execution, is rated lower.
The scores are 4.05, 4.14, and 3.80 for the phase, step, and action levels, respectively, showing that the annotations generally align well with the video progress.

blocks.en:
Hierarchical coverage evaluates whether lower-level executions sufficiently cover the content required by the higher-level procedure.
We examine whether the phases cover the activities needed to achieve the goal, the steps cover each phase, and the actions cover each step, focusing on whether any essential execution is missing.
The scores are 4.35, 4.50, and 4.48, respectively, indicating strong coverage across all levels.

得分分别为4.35分,4.50分和4.48分,表明所有各级的覆盖率都很高.

blocks.en:
Goal relevance evaluates whether the selected executions and guidance contribute to achieving the task goal.
Preparatory, safety-related, and recovery events that are necessary to achieve the task goal are considered relevant, whereas events unrelated to the goal are rated lower.
The scores are 4.48, 4.41, and 4.39, respectively, showing high goal relevance across all levels.
blocks.zh:
目标的相关性评估了选定的处决和指导是否有助于实现任务目标。
为实现任务目标所必须的筹备、安全及恢复活动被认为是相关的,而与目标无关的活动则被评为较低。
得分分别为4.48分,4.41分和4.39分,显示在所有级别都具有很高的目标相关性.

blocks.en:
Guidance quality evaluates whether each guidance sentence clearly and accurately describes what the user should do at the corresponding level.
Lower scores are assigned when the guidance is unclear, difficult to follow, or does not match the intended level of detail.
The scores are 4.37, 4.16, and 4.16, respectively, indicating that the generated guidance is generally clear and appropriate for each level.

分数分别为4.37分,4.16分和4.16分,表明所生成的指向一般清晰并适合每个级别.

blocks.en: Appendix I Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录一 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation uses ground-truth dialogue history rather than model-generated outputs. When the model uses its own output history, further evaluation is needed to assess error accumulation and its ability to revise plans. In addition, guidance-level adaptation focuses on user-requested changes. Further research could explore how to infer the user’s expertise and understanding to adjust the guidance level automatically, potentially making assistance more useful in real-world interactions. Also, since some activities can be performed in different orders to achieve the same goal, evaluation methods that consider these alternatives are needed. Future work should extend training and evaluation to support long-term task tracking and plan revision, personalized guidance, and multiple valid execution orders.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价采用了地面-真相对话历史,而不是模型产出。 当模型使用自己的产出历史时,需要进一步评价以评估出错的积累及其修改计划的能力. 此外,指导层面的适应侧重于用户要求的改变。 进一步研究可以探讨如何推断用户的专长和理解,以便自动调整指导水平,从而有可能使援助在现实世界的互动中更加有用。 此外,由于为实现同一目标可以按不同顺序开展一些活动,因此需要采用考虑这些替代办法的评价方法。 今后的工作应扩大培训和评价范围,支持长期任务跟踪和计划修订、个性化指导和多项有效的执行命令。
